detail.name: The Bloom of Asphodels
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Trigger's Mindscape: Beyond the River of the Dead
detail.desc2:
A card featuring a private photo of Trigger.
"Proxy, please come a little closer... close enough that you won't slip through my fingers."
"I want to remember the outline of the person who trusted me with their back... Is this selfish? If it is, then let me be a little selfish."
